words.hidden: The names and addresses are in the panel.
words.counted: {{count}} events of this kind, counted together by the security record.
words.mergedWhy: The message that told it could not be sent while it lasted.
words.summaryWhat: These were not sent one by one, so that the chat is not flooded:
words.summaryTodo: look at the notifications or the security record in the panel.
words.summaryMeans: Nothing was lost: every event is in the panel.

auth.mfa.locked.label: Two-factor check locked
auth.mfa.locked.preview: Two-factor locked for {{actor}}: someone has the password
auth.mfa.locked.what: Too many wrong two-factor codes were typed for the account {{actor}}, from {{ip}}. The check is locked for a while.
auth.mfa.locked.means: Whoever typed them knew the password of this account.
auth.mfa.locked.todo: if it was not you, change the password of {{actor}} now and look at its sessions.

access.grant.denied.label: Permission grant refused
access.grant.denied.preview: {{actor}} tried to grant a permission they lack
access.grant.denied.what: The account {{actor}} (from {{ip}}) tried to hand out the permission {{permission}}, which it does not hold itself. It was refused.
access.grant.denied.means: An account tried to raise its own rights or someone else's.
access.grant.denied.todo: if this was not expected, look at what {{actor}} did in the security record.

shield.ban.temporary.label: Client banned for a while
shield.ban.temporary.what: SmartShield banned the client {{ip}} after three strikes ({{reason}}).
shield.ban.temporary.means: It cannot reach Cosmos until the ban ends.
shield.ban.temporary.todo: nothing, unless it is one of your own devices: then lift the ban in the panel.

shield.ban.permanent.label: Client banned for good
shield.ban.permanent.what: SmartShield banned the client {{ip}} until it is unbanned ({{reason}}).
shield.ban.permanent.means: It cannot reach Cosmos any more.
shield.ban.permanent.todo: nothing, unless it is one of your own devices: then lift the ban in the panel.

user.role.changed.label: Role of an account changed
user.role.changed.what: {{actor}} changed the role of the account {{target}} to {{role}}, from {{ip}}.
user.role.changed.means: What this account may do in Cosmos changed.
user.role.changed.todo: if it was not you, take the role back under Users and change your password.

host.terminal.opened.label: Terminal opened on the server
host.terminal.opened.preview: Root terminal opened on the server by {{actor}}
host.terminal.opened.what: {{actor}} opened a terminal on the server itself, as root, from {{ip}}.
host.terminal.opened.means: Whoever holds it can do anything on this machine.
host.terminal.opened.todo: if it was not you, sign out every session of {{actor}} and change its password.

snapshot.restore.started.label: Snapshot restore started
snapshot.restore.started.what: {{actor}} started replacing the folder {{target}} with its snapshot {{snapshot}}, from {{ip}}.
snapshot.restore.started.means: The folder's current content is being replaced.
snapshot.restore.started.todo: if it was not you, look at the server now.

server.update.rejected.label: Unsigned update refused
server.update.rejected.what: The release {{target}} was not installed because it could not be verified as signed by this fork ({{reason}}).
server.update.rejected.means: The server stays on its version. A release that does not verify may have been tampered with.
server.update.rejected.todo: do not install that release by hand; wait for the next one.

upnp.port.opened.label: Port opened on the router
upnp.port.opened.what: {{actor}} asked the router to forward a port to {{target}}, from {{ip}}.
upnp.port.opened.means: The app is reachable from the internet directly, without Cosmos' sign-in.
upnp.port.opened.todo: if it was not you, close the port in the app's Internet settings.

expose.opened.label: App exposed to the internet
expose.opened.means: Anyone on the internet can now reach this app; a forwarded port reaches it without Cosmos' sign-in.
expose.opened.todo: if it was not you, withdraw it in the app's Internet settings.

edge.blocked.label: Address blocked at Cloudflare
edge.blocked.what: The address {{ip}} kept offending through Cloudflare ({{reason}}); Cloudflare now blocks or challenges it for a limited time ({{via}}).
edge.blocked.means: It does not reach the server while the block lasts.
edge.blocked.todo: nothing, unless it was a mistake: then lift it under Configuration > Domains.

sample.via: an IP Access Rule of the domain

auth.login.failed.label: Failed sign-in
auth.login.failed.what: A sign-in as {{target}} from {{ip}} was refused ({{reason}}).
auth.login.failed.means: Someone typed a wrong password or a user that does not exist.
auth.login.failed.todo: nothing if it was you; many of them from one address are banned by SmartShield and Fail2ban.

auth.mfa.failed.label: Wrong two-factor code
auth.mfa.failed.what: A wrong two-factor code was typed for {{actor}} from {{ip}}, after a correct password.
auth.mfa.failed.means: Whoever typed it knows the password of {{actor}}.
auth.mfa.failed.todo: if it was not you, change the password of {{actor}}.

auth.sudo.failed.label: Wrong password at the confirmation
auth.sudo.failed.what: {{actor}}, signed in, typed a wrong password at the confirmation prompt, from {{ip}}.
auth.sudo.failed.means: Someone who holds a session of {{actor}} does not know its password.
auth.sudo.failed.todo: if it was not you, sign out the sessions of {{actor}}.

auth.session.forged.label: Forged session
auth.session.forged.what: A session cookie this server did not sign was presented from {{ip}}.
auth.session.forged.means: Someone tries to get in without signing in. It was refused.
auth.session.forged.todo: nothing; repeated, the address is banned.

scan.probe.label: Probe for a known weakness
scan.probe.what: {{ip}} asked for a path that scanners look for ({{probe}}).
scan.probe.means: A robot looks for a weak spot. It got nothing.
scan.probe.todo: nothing; repeated, the address is banned.

shield.strike.label: SmartShield strike
shield.strike.what: SmartShield gave the client {{ip}} a strike ({{reason}}).
shield.strike.means: At three strikes it is banned.

firewall.ban.label: Fail2ban banned an address
firewall.ban.what: Fail2ban banned {{ip}} at the firewall, in the jail {{jail}}.
firewall.ban.means: That address cannot reach any service of this server until the ban ends.
firewall.ban.todo: nothing, unless it is one of your devices: then unban it under Security.

config.saved.label: Settings changed
config.saved.means: The server works with the new settings from now on.
config.saved.todo: if it was not you, look at the security record and change your password.

user.created.label: Account created
user.created.means: Someone new can sign in once the invitation is used.
user.created.todo: if it was not you, delete the account under Users.

user.deleted.label: Account deleted
user.deleted.means: That person can no longer sign in.
user.deleted.todo: if it was not you, look at the security record.

auth.password.changed.label: Password changed
auth.password.changed.what: The password of {{actor}} was changed from {{ip}}.
auth.password.changed.means: The old password no longer works.
auth.password.changed.todo: if it was not you, reset it from another administrator account at once.

token.created.label: API token created
token.created.means: A program holding it can use the API with the token's rights.
token.created.todo: if it was not you, delete it under Configuration > API tokens.

container.terminal.opened.label: Terminal opened in an app
container.terminal.opened.what: {{actor}} opened a terminal inside the container {{target}} from {{ip}}.
container.terminal.opened.means: Whoever holds it can change that app and read its data.
container.terminal.opened.todo: if it was not you, look at the security record.

credentials.revealed.label: Sign-in details shown
credentials.revealed.what: {{actor}} looked at the sign-in details of {{target}} from {{ip}}.
credentials.revealed.means: They can now sign in to that app.
credentials.revealed.todo: if it was not you, change the app's password.

recorder.dropped.label: Security events lost
recorder.dropped.what: The security record could not keep up and lost {{count}} events.
recorder.dropped.means: Some events are missing from the record; the server works as before.
recorder.dropped.todo: look at what caused the flood in the security dashboard.

auth.login.new.label: Sign-in from a new address
auth.login.new.what: A password was accepted for {{actor}} from {{ip}}, an address not seen before for this account.
auth.login.new.means: That is you on a new network, or someone who has the password.
auth.login.new.todo: if it was not you, change the password of {{actor}} and sign out its sessions.

security.other.label: Security event
security.other.means: It is kept in the security record with who, from where and what.
security.other.todo: look at the security record if it was not expected.

sample.subject: editor · 192.168.1.20
sample._description: An action was refused because the account lacks the permission.

smart.failing.label: Disk failing (S.M.A.R.T.)
smart.failing.todo: copy what matters off this disk now, and plan to replace it.

sample.reason: 12 reallocated sectors (5 more since the last check)

disk.filling.label: Disk filling fast
disk.filling.preview: {{mount}} full in about {{left}} at this rate
disk.filling.todo: find what grows (downloads, logs, backups) and free space or move it.

docker.down.label: Docker does not answer
docker.down.todo: on the server: systemctl status docker, and the free space of its disk.

docker.restored.label: Docker answers again
docker.restored.todo: nothing; look at the apps if some did not start again.

snapshots.late.label: No recent snapshot
snapshots.late.todo: look at the incremental backup card: the destination disk and the last run's errors.

update.proven.label: Update proved itself
update.proven.preview: Version {{version}} proved itself after its update

login.newcountry.label: Sign-in from a new country
login.newcountry.preview: {{user}} signed in from {{country}}, a new country
login.newcountry.todo: if it was not you, change the password of {{user}} and sign out its sessions.

smart.unreadable.label: Disk cannot be read
smart.unreadable.preview: Disk {{disk}} cannot be read any more
smart.unreadable.todo: look at the disk now: copy what matters off it if it still mounts.

smart.unwatchable.label: Disk health not watched
smart.unwatchable.preview: Health of {{disk}} not watched (it could wake)
smart.unwatchable.todo: nothing; connect the disk directly (not through USB) to have it watched.

watch.stuck.label: A check does not answer
watch.stuck.preview: The check of {{what}} does not answer
watch.stuck.todo: look for a disk or a network share that hangs (an NFS or SMB mount).

smart.readable.label: Disk can be read again
smart.readable.todo: nothing; keep an eye on it.

docker.unwatched.label: Docker no longer watched
docker.unwatched.todo: switch the watch on again to know when Docker answers.

upnp.forward.failed.label: Router stopped forwarding a port
upnp.forward.failed.todo: check the router's UPnP setting; Cosmos tries again by itself.

upnp.router.unreachable.label: Router does not answer
upnp.router.unreachable.preview: Router does not answer: port forwards at risk
upnp.router.unreachable.todo: check that the router is on and UPnP is enabled on it.

upnp.config.invalid.label: Port forwarding settings refused
upnp.config.invalid.preview: Router refuses the port forwarding settings
upnp.config.invalid.todo: correct the router settings under Configuration > Internet.

cert.order.failed.label: No certificate obtained
cert.order.failed.means: Visitors of this name get a warning or no connection until a certificate is obtained.
cert.order.failed.todo: read the reason and fix the DNS or the provider's token; Cosmos tries again.

sample.reason: the DNS provider refused the token

cert.expiring.label: Certificate ends soon
cert.expiring.todo: open the certificates card and renew it, or fix what stops the renewal.

cert.untrusted.label: Addresses without a trusted certificate
cert.untrusted.todo: give these names a certificate from Let's Encrypt in the certificates card.

container.updated.label: App updated
container.updated.todo: nothing; if it misbehaves, look at its logs.

container.update.failed.label: App could not be updated
container.update.failed.todo: open the app's page: start it if it is stopped, and read its log.

container.dying.label: App keeps stopping
container.dying.todo: open the app's page and read the end of its log.

container.startFailed.label: New app does not start
container.startFailed.todo: open the app's page and press "Why?": Cosmos offers the settings its log asks for.

container.leftover.label: Interrupted change of an app
container.leftover.todo: open ServApps: put the old container back or remove it.

app.installed.label: App installed
app.installed.todo: nothing; its sign-in details are on its page.

app.installMail.failed.label: Installation e-mail not sent
app.installMail.failed.todo: check the e-mail settings; the details are on the app's page.

sample.name: nextcloud
sample.reason: the mail server refused the sender

snapshots.failed.label: Incremental backup had problems
snapshots.failed.todo: open Backups and look at the folders that failed.

alert.disk.label: Disk nearly full
alert.disk.todo: free space on it, or move data to another disk.

alert.triggered.label: Monitoring alert
alert.triggered.todo: open Monitoring to see the value that went past its limit.

fail2ban.down.label: Fail2ban not running
fail2ban.down.preview: Fail2ban not running: no firewall bans
fail2ban.down.todo: on the server: systemctl status fail2ban.

update.rejected.label: Server update refused
update.rejected.todo: do not install that release by hand; the next one is tried as usual.

update.rolledback.label: Server update undone
update.rolledback.todo: nothing now; that version is not offered again.

update.attention.label: Server update needs attention
update.attention.todo: follow cosmos-update.README in the installation folder.

sample.summary: the previous version could not be restored

deps.failed.label: Dependency update failed
deps.failed.preview: Dependency update failed: needs a session
deps.failed.todo: start a session on the repository; this server keeps its version.

deps.paused.label: Dependency updates paused
deps.paused.todo: switch the workflow on again on GitHub when you want them.

deps.stale.label: Dependency update has not run
deps.stale.todo: look at the workflow on GitHub: it may be disabled.

reach.down.label: Cosmos unreachable from the internet
reach.down.means: Nobody outside your home reaches the panel or the apps; at home everything works.
reach.down.todo: check the router's port forward to this server; Cosmos keeps testing.

edgeblock.problem.label: Blocks at Cloudflare paused
edgeblock.problem.what: Cosmos cannot make or lift blocks at Cloudflare for {{text}}: the domain's token lacks a permission or is refused.
edgeblock.problem.todo: add the permission named in the panel to the token in Cloudflare's dashboard.

originpull.expiring.label: Cloudflare certificate ends soon
originpull.expiring.what: The certificate Cloudflare presents to this server ends in {{text}}.
originpull.expiring.means: After that, requests through Cloudflare are refused while the check is enforced.
originpull.expiring.todo: follow the steps in the Cloudflare card.

originpull.stopped.label: Cloudflare certificate check back to testing
originpull.stopped.preview: Cloudflare certificate check back to testing
originpull.stopped.what: Requiring a certificate from Cloudflare's proxy was not confirmed in time; it is back to testing and nothing is refused.
originpull.stopped.todo: confirm it again in the Cloudflare card when it works.

turnstile.problem.label: Sign-in check unavailable
turnstile.problem.what: Cloudflare's sign-in check cannot be used: it does not answer, or it refuses the secret key.
turnstile.problem.means: Visitors from the internet cannot sign in meanwhile; the home network can.
turnstile.problem.todo: from home, check the keys under Configuration > Domains > Sign-in check.

error.backup.label: Configuration backup failed
error.backup.todo: check the free space and the backup folder.

error.job.label: Scheduled job failed
error.job.todo: open Scheduled jobs and read its last output.

error.snapraid.label: SnapRAID task failed
error.snapraid.todo: open Storage > Parity and read the task's output.

error.internet.label: No internet connection
error.internet.todo: check the router and the server's network cable.

error.database.label: Database problem
error.database.todo: look at the server's log and the free space.

error.export.label: Export of the apps' settings failed
error.export.preview: Export of the apps' settings failed
error.export.todo: check Docker and the free space.

error.migration.label: Old settings not carried over
error.migration.preview: Old settings could not be carried over
error.migration.todo: check the settings named in the panel.

error.socketproxy.label: Two URLs on one port
error.socketproxy.preview: Two URLs want the same port
error.socketproxy.todo: give one of the URLs another port.

error.mail.label: E-mail not sent
error.mail.todo: check the e-mail settings and send a test e-mail.

error.setup.label: Setup step failed
error.setup.todo: repeat the step in the setup.

sample.message: the certificate could not be made

error.other.label: Server error
error.other.todo: look at the notification in the panel.

sample.message: the remote storage did not answer

notification.other.label: Notification
notification.other.todo: look at it in the panel.

update.available.label: Server update available
update.available.what: Version {{version}} is available; this server runs {{current}}.
update.available.whatAuto: Version {{version}} is available; this server runs {{current}}. It is installed automatically at {{at}}.
update.available.todo: nothing if updates are automatic; otherwise install it under Configuration > General.

update.failed.label: Server update not installed
update.failed.what: The update to {{version}} could not be installed; Cosmos keeps running the current version.
update.failed.todo: read the reason; the next attempt is made by itself.

update.installed.label: Server updated
update.installed.what: Cosmos was updated from {{from}} to {{version}} and is running again.

update.failed.start.label: Update came back on the old version
update.failed.start.what: The server update was not installed: Cosmos started again with version {{version}}.
update.failed.start.todo: nothing now; the next attempt is made by itself.

cosmos.restarted.label: Cosmos restarted
cosmos.restarted.preview: Cosmos restarted after a change of settings
cosmos.restarted.what: Cosmos restarted, as asked for in the panel or after a change of settings. Running version {{version}}.

cosmos.signal.label: Cosmos started after a stop or reboot
cosmos.signal.preview: Cosmos back after a stop or reboot
cosmos.signal.what: Cosmos started again after it was stopped by the system: the service was stopped or restarted, or the machine rebooted. Running version {{version}}.
cosmos.signal.todo: nothing, if you rebooted it; otherwise ask who did.

cosmos.crashed.label: Cosmos started after a crash
cosmos.crashed.preview: Cosmos back after a crash or power loss
cosmos.crashed.what: Cosmos started again after an unexpected stop: a crash, a kill or a power loss. Running version {{version}}.
cosmos.crashed.todo: look at the server's log (journalctl -u CosmosCloud) around that time.

cosmos.restarting.label: Cosmos keeps restarting
cosmos.restarting.what: Cosmos started several times within ten minutes. Running version {{version}}. Further starts are not announced for an hour.
cosmos.restarting.means: The panel and the apps behind it come and go.
cosmos.restarting.todo: look at the server's log (journalctl -u CosmosCloud) now.

address.changed.label: Public address changed
address.changed.what: The server's address on the internet changed from {{old}} to {{new}}.
address.changed.means: Visitors reach the server through the new address once the records point to it.
address.changed.todo: nothing if the records were updated; otherwise update them under Configuration > Domains.

telegram.test.label: Test message
telegram.test.what: Notifications from this server arrive in this chat.

telegram.moved.label: Telegram notifications taken away
telegram.moved.what: The Telegram notifications of this server {{_what}}: this chat no longer receives them as before.
telegram.moved.means: If that was not you, someone with an administrator's session changed them.
telegram.moved.todo: if it was not you, look at the server.
